entities.name: Wasitora
entities.description: Queen of the nekoru cat-dragons on Dominaria, a wild nekoru with natural green-mana healing.

entities.name: Mayonako
entities.description: Alpha male nekoru who mated with Wasitora.

entities.name: Tetsuo Umezawa
entities.description: Imperial champion who made Wasitora his deputy and later swore vengeance on the Emperor.

entities.name: Umezawa Manor
entities.description: Defended by Wasitora against the kentsu.

entities.name: Madara-Edemi War
entities.description: War at whose onset Wasitora settled near Sekana.

events.summary: At twenty Wasitora defeats all other females at the annual mating gathering and claims the title of queen.
events.quote: Wasitora defeated all females of the group, claiming the title of queen for herself

events.summary: Wasitora mates with Mayonako and decides to travel to Madara to start a new wild lineage.
events.quote: After mating with Mayonako , the alpha male of the group

events.summary: Tetsuo duels Wasitora, an Elder Land Wurm interrupts, and he appoints her deputy and defender of Sekana.
events.quote: he appointed her deputy of the imperial champion office and defender of the port city, paid in fish

events.summary: Wasitora gives birth to six kittens and defends Umezawa Manor against the kentsu.
events.quote: Wasitora took her kittens to Umezawa Manor and defended it against the kentsu

relations.quote: Wasitora was the queen of the nekoru cat - dragons on Dominaria
